user_decisions.vendor_runtime: Wine and Nikon DLLs are research oracles only, not a product backend
user_decisions.secondary_interchange: Linear DNG research and downstream compatibility
user_decisions.public_artifacts: English only; repository text is ASCII

current_capabilities.inspect: Metadata and file hashes via ExifTool
current_capabilities.merge: Experimental native complete 4/8/16/32-frame Z8 sequence to one NEFX
current_capabilities.sequence_validation: Explicit capture order, consecutive shot numbers, consistent observed metadata, no duplicate files
current_capabilities.nefx_writer: Native packed14 RGB, Nikon metadata updates and CRCs, private preview, preserved source JPEGs, atomic no-overwrite publication
current_capabilities.dng: Secondary library/research path with raw-sample and Adobe SDK validation
current_capabilities.flexible_color: First-release requirement; actual color processing not implemented

acceptance_boundaries: Synthetic fixture and saved vendor-output agreement is not authentic capture validation.
LibRaw or Adobe SDK decoding is not Lightroom Classic acceptance.
Preserving Picture Control metadata is not applying Picture Control rendering.
Predicting Adobe default properties is not reproducing Nikon color transforms.
A readable NEFX with the right samples is not byte-identical Nikon serialization.
release_gaps: Authentic pixel-shift capture and downstream application references
Native radial correction and 8/32-frame Adobe default updates
Multiple-output merge modes at the CLI boundary
HE/HE* decoding, HLG, non-FX image areas and firmware coverage
Flexible Color/Picture Control formats, parameters, processing order and rendering fidelity
Bounded full-resolution memory use and cross-platform packaging
